SURE.gloss: having or feeling no doubt or uncertainty
SURE.definition: Having or feeling no doubt or uncertainty; confident and assured.

ROSE.gloss: any of many shrubs of the genus Rosa that bear roses
ROSE.definition: Any of many shrubs of the genus Rosa that bear roses.

USER.gloss: a person who makes use of a thing
USER.definition: A person who makes use of a thing; someone who uses or employs something.

EURO.gloss: the basic monetary unit of most members of the European Union
EURO.definition: The basic monetary unit of most members of the European Union (introduced in 1999); in 2002 twelve European nations (Germany, France, Belgium, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Italy, Spain, Portugal, Ireland, Greece, Austria, Finland) adopted the euro as their basic unit of money and abandoned their traditional currencies.

SORE.example: The tender spot on his jaw.

USE.example: He warned against the use of narcotic drugs.

SUE.definition: Institute legal proceedings against; file a suit against.
SUE.example: He was warned that the district attorney would process him.

ORE.gloss: a mineral that contains metal that is valuable enough to be mined
ORE.definition: A mineral that contains metal that is valuable enough to be mined.

RUSE.definition: A deceptive maneuver (especially to avoid capture).
